title: UFOs over Bariloche nuclear site
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFOs over Bariloche nuclear site, about 1995 at Bariloche, Argentina, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that UFOs have been seen buzzing around Bariloche, a city in Argentina that he says has its own civilian nuclear energy grid. He places a famous case there in 1995 and, in one telling, adds that it involved a commercial plane, though another time he gives no year. He raises it as one more example of UFOs appearing near nuclear sites.
